# PocketDNA POPLIST — population and sample selection catalog

Version 1 · 3 November 2026 · metadata-based selection planning

[Product scope](ABOUT.md) · [Scientific specification](BIOINFORMATICS.md) · [Dataset intake](../dataset/README.md)

Source status: the tables preserve the earlier annotation audit. Its original source files are not bundled in this checkout; checksums below record the expected inputs, not files newly verified here. All records remain candidates pending current-release, identity, genotype and rights checks. Historical research is background subject to RULES eligibility/attribution, not automatically new hackathon work.

This is a searchable **candidate and review catalog**, not a ready-to-run smartpca poplist or a blanket recommendation to include every listed sample. It draws on the supplied v62 HO and 1240K annotation CSVs, the earlier 6,881-ID panel, the v66 1240K patch `.ind`, and BIOINFORMATICS.md section 17. Genotypes, current-release quality and relationships remain to be checked.

This intentionally extensive catalog contains 8,374 present-day records, 222 targeted/selected non-present-day records, and all 550 historical population summaries. All 6,881 historical selected IDs are accounted for. Use editor search for an exact population or sample ID. The ancient selection is targeted, not an exhaustive catalog of all ancient AADR records. Repeated appearance of an ID in a warning appendix does not indicate another sample.

## How to use this document

1. Select a scientific role: PCA basis, projection-only reference, era-mixture source, or held-out evaluation.
2. Find the population in the named recommendations or alphabetical modern catalog. Copy **Genetic IDs exactly**, retaining suffixes.
3. Group records by Master ID and select at most one representation per person for a basis. Keep all representations in the same train/test split.
4. Resolve flags, annotation-release mismatches and external-study identities. Then measure call rate on the actual retained SNP panel and run relatedness/QC checks.
5. Generate tool inputs from the approved individual manifest. smartpca's population-label list and its individual `.ind` file must agree; neither this Markdown nor FINALPOPLIST.txt is that input.

### Reading the tables

- **Old panel yes:** exact ID was in FINALPOPLIST.panel_ids.txt.
- **Same Master selected:** an alternate representation of this person was selected; this is not an additional individual.
- **No exact/Master match:** no match among annotated selected records; unresolved external IDs can still represent this person.
- **Panels:** annotation CSV membership, not independent datasets or independent people.
- **v66 1240K ID:** only exact presence in the supplied patch `.ind`. “Not in supplied file” does not prove absence from v66 Human Origins or other files.
- **Hits:** supplied counts on HO and 1240K target sets, not coverage of the final PCA SNP set. Unknown is not zero.
- **Assessment:** from the v62 1240K CSV for this exact representation. HO has no equivalent field; UNKNOWN is not PASS.
- **Action:** conservative triage based on metadata, never a validated inclusion decision. Review the detailed warning appendix as well.

The tables retain rejected/flagged variants to prevent accidental substitution; they must not be copied wholesale into a basis.

## Selection policy carried over from BIOINFORMATICS.md

Start with a high-quality, unrelated modern diploid basis as a production candidate; compare the audited historical basis and a controlled ancient-anchor variant. Project ancient samples by default. Basis membership does not automatically make a population an appropriate ancestry-mixture source. Keep geographically and temporally heterogeneous proxies separate.

Do not use a higher G25 alignment score as the only selection rule. The earlier reported 0.78 “ceiling” is not a proven ceiling. Evaluate consumer-chip transfer, technical batch effects, regional performance and mixture stability on fixed held-out people. A large population's extra samples do not necessarily add a new genetic direction.

Confirmed selected duplicate Master-ID pairs: BOT2016.SG/AG; I11974.AG/SG; I1583.DG/SG; Sumidouro5.SG/Sumidouro5_d.SG. Mota remains partly unresolved in v62. Selkup4 and Selkup4a have distinct v62 Master IDs; names alone do not establish duplication.

Nine selected ancient records were QUESTIONABLE in v62: I0867.AG, TAF013.AG, La368.SG, Ma912.SG, MA1.SG, TAF011.AG, TAF010.AG, Sumidouro6.SG and Sumidouro5.SG. Quarantine unresolved warnings from a production basis; assess alternative representations and projection-only use after review.

## Recommended roles and requested populations

| Population/family | Selection intent |
| --- | --- |
| Druze | Retain geographic representation after duplicate/relative QC; avoid adding all DG versions on top of selected HO people. Modern affinity reference, not a generic ancient Levant proxy. |
| BedouinA / BedouinB | Preserve their distinct sampling labels; assess each separately. Neither is an interchangeable pure ancestral source. |
| Samaritan | Only one v62 record in the named group; useful exploratory reference after QC, inadequate for population-level precision or within-group validation. |
| Sardinian / Italian_Sardinian | Keep original sample definitions and review identities across labels. Modern Sardinians are not substitutes for ancient Anatolian farmers. |
| Mayan | Retain modern context; distinguish SG and DG/HO call types and flagged subgroups. Do not use as a universal ancient American proxy. |
| Orcadian | Regional reference with alternate assays; check identity and relationships before expanding. |
| English | Exact named records exist, alongside separately labeled GBR samples. Do not merge labels without reviewing sampling definitions. |
| English_Cornwall | No Group ID with this exact label or a Cornwall/Cornish group label was found in either export. Generic English and GBR are not equivalent. Cornwall appears in ancient locality metadata; those are not modern English_Cornwall samples. Obtain the original study/ID mapping before adding this label. |
| Nganasan / Selkup / Ket | Limited depth experiments after reconciling aliases and external IDs. Candidate counts are not expected performance gains. |
| Southeast Asia / Oceania | Investigate regional coverage using Kankanaey, Murut, Flores, Mentawai and Baining examples; reconcile EGDP/SGDP identities first. |
| PUR / CLM / ACB / PEL / MXL / ASW | Strong held-out admixture-transfer test candidates; don't silently use them for tuning and final testing. |
| Natufian | Ancient projection and carefully specified source modeling; compare damaged/low-coverage/contamination variants before use. |
| Anatolian Neolithic Farmer | A proxy family, not one exact Group ID. Barcin Neolithic, Boncuklu PPN and other Anatolian groups must remain distinguishable by place/date and ancestry. |

Catalog checks: 21,945 unique annotation IDs in the union; 8,374 present-day records listed; 222 selected/targeted non-present-day records listed; 1,123 historical panel IDs unresolved. Every selected exact match is represented in either the modern or non-present-day catalog.


Before emitting the final basis list, require one chosen assay per Master ID; approved role; exact current genotype ID; independent relationship check; supported genotype type; measured final-SNP overlap; explicit exclusion reasons; and immutable train/test assignment. The 550-group historical summary is not a scientifically required target size.

Do not call an unused alternate assay a new population. Do not interpret an absent exact label as biological absence. Keep a separate unresolved-alias queue, especially English_Cornwall and historic canonical names. The result of this document should be an auditable individual manifest, followed by a generated smartpca poplist—not manual copying of all visible records.
